title: 64-point optimization ablation
coverage: N64 TF32 unit-kernel timings; radix4_compute selects the new shared_stage_radix4 reconstruction (marked ‡), with stage-wise shared-memory loads/stores, source/binary hashes, and unconfirmed original paper identity. The reduced-communication row selects a partial kernel (about 0.0079 ms on A100), with omitted MMA operand setup and unchecked accuracy retained. All five available kernels run in default timing-only mode; explicit validation checks the three complete-FFT candidates at R=1. Radix16 is estimated from validated Table 6 tcFFT at retained utilization. Missing selected reconstruction measurements fail the complete pipeline; exact original paper-stage identities remain unconfirmed.

presentation.comparison_formula: 100 * (new - paper) / abs(paper); absolute value is relative error
notes: Each original numeric column has three columns: Paper, New, and Δ%, with a blank separator between groups. Δ% = (New − Paper) / |Paper| × 100; its absolute value is the relative error.
Paper values are the rounded numbers printed in the supplied PDF. — means missing or not exactly comparable; model values and estimates retain their stated scope.
— denotes an unavailable measurement. Missing original stages are not replaced by retained paper numbers.
Recovered candidates are displayed under their proposed paper roles; exact original-stage identities remain unconfirmed.
The original radix-16 baseline is unavailable; speedups relative to that baseline remain unreported.
Paper references are the printed values. Differences for * and † rows retain the same estimate and timing-only qualifications; they do not establish a validated FFT reproduction.
Additional native variants remain in kernel_comparison.csv; only the explicit paper-row source mapping selects a displayed stage.
